It can also update your AI skills and developer package managers in one pass, including Homebrew, npm, pip, gems, and rustup.

Modes
•	Deep — full 15-phase audit and cleanup
•	Quick — fast cache cleanup plus Homebrew updates
•	Audit — report only, with no changes made
•	Update — refresh AI skills and package managers

name: upload-post
description: Publish to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky and Snapchat. Long-form video, short clips, photos, carousels, text, threads, documents and link previews. Schedule cross-platform, repurpose long videos into viral shorts with AI, build Instagram comment-to-DM funnels (AutoDMs), and track analytics. Backed by the Upload-Post MCP server (40+ tools) plus six opinionated skills and three subagents for content strategy, autodm architecture, and upload debugging. Free plan, no credit card required

name: urc
description: Control Codex and Gemini from the Claude app on your phone. URC spawns a lightweight Haiku relay that bridges your phone's Remote Control session to any Codex or Gemini pane running in tmux. One app, three AI ecosystems. Also includes a cross-CLI teams protocol for structured agent-to-agent communication via MCP.

name: usap-skills
description: 66 LLM security agent skills for the Unified Security Agent Platform (USAP). Covers threat detection, incident response, red team operations, cloud security, identity risk, compliance mapping, DevSecOps, and AI security. Use any skill standalone or as part of a USAP orchestration chain.

name: usectl
description: Deploy and manage full-stack projects on usectl — a managed Kubernetes platform that turns a GitHub repo into a live HTTPS app with PostgreSQL, S3 storage, and automatic SSL. Includes deployment skill with full lifecycle knowledge, MCP server integration for direct API access, and slash commands (/deploy, /status, /logs) for quick operations. One prompt deploys your entire project.

name: using-cmux
description: A Claude Code plugin that teaches the agent to operate cmux, a terminal multiplexer with first-class agent integration. Provides skill patterns and shell wrappers (cmux-send, cmux-read, cmux-send-key, cmux-grid, cfork) for the full sub-agent lifecycle: launch -> trust detection -> prompt -> completion detection -> result collection. Browser automation is covered to the depth needed for a single agent. Companion plugin cmux-team handles multi-agent orchestration on top of using-cmux. macOS / Linux only.

name: uttero
description:
Uttero is a voice channel that lets Claude Code take and make phone calls during a coding session. An incoming call arrives as a channel notification; Claude hears the caller's transcription, speaks back via TTS through the `reply` tool, and keeps editing your codebase between turns. Works like a live collaborator who happens to be on a phone line.

Tools exposed: reply (speak), call_user (outbound), end_call, list_calls.

Audio, transcription, and TTS are handled by Uttero's hosted backend (api.uttero.dev). The plugin itself is ~500 lines of TypeScript that speaks MCP stdio and authenticated HTTPS. Credentials are stored locally at ~/.uttero/credentials.json (mode 600) and never shared with callers. The plugin deliberately omits `capabilities.experimental['claude/channel/permission']` so voice callers cannot approve Bash/Write/Edit tool use.

name: ux-design
description: UX and UI design skills including Refactoring UI, iOS HIG design, usability heuristics, habit-forming product design, behavior design for retention, web typography, award-winning top-design, Steve Jobs-style design reviews, and Don Norman's foundational design principles

name: ux-strategy
description: UX strategy skills: information architecture, content strategy, navigation patterns, user flows, task analysis, and competitive UX audits.

name: ux-superpowers
description:
User-centered design methodology for coding agents. Before you brainstorm solutions or write code, UX Superpowers guides you through structured UX discovery: identifying who you're building for (personas), what they're trying to accomplish (jobs-to-be-done), how they experience the problem today (user journey maps), and how you'll know if you succeeded (telemetry and success metrics). Accepts raw user research data (interviews,
surveys, support tickets, analytics) or guides discovery from scratch. Produces a UX Discovery Document that anchors all subsequent development. Currently ships 8 skills and works for any software type - web apps, CLIS, APIs, mobile, infrastructure, internal tools, games. Eventually there will be more skills that help in UX Discovery. Designed to complement the Superpowers plugin by owning the "what and why" before the "how".

name: validate-plugin
description: Validate Claude Code plugin structure against official Anthropic spec and Intent Solutions enterprise standard with 100-point grading.

name: vanikya-ai-mcp
description:
Vanikya AI MCP connects Claude Code to Vanikya AI platform, giving you image generation, SEO analysis, creative insights, and credits management all directly from Claude.
Generate stunning images, videos, vectors, and lottie animations using 16+ models including GPT-Image-1.5, Flux 2 Pro, and Google's Nano Banana. Run AI-powered SEO audits on any URL (single or batch). Get creative scoring and branding feedback on images. Check your credit balance and top up  without leaving your terminal.

Powered by an OAuth-authenticated MCP server with guided skills that handle the full workflow: prompt enhancement, credit estimation, generation, and polling.

name: vanta-mcp-plugin
description:
The Vanta plugin connects Claude Code to Vanta's security and compliance platform through the Vanta MCP server. It combines Vanta's test-specific remediation intelligence with your local repository context to help you fix compliance failures faster.

What it does:
- Connects to Vanta's hosted MCP server via OAuth, giving Claude access to your tests, controls, vendors, vulnerabilities, policies, and framework requirements
- Adds a remediation skill that pulls test-specific remediation instructions from Vanta and combines them with your local repo to generate targeted IaC fixes
- Includes slash commands for streamlined test remediation workflows

Skills:
- Remediation — Describe a failing test or paste a test ID, and the plugin generates step-by-step remediation guidance. For IaC tests, it scans your repo and produces ready-to-apply code fixes for Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, CDK, and other IaC tools.

Slash commands:

/vanta:list-tests — View failing compliance tests, prioritized by what you can fix from your current repo
/vanta:fix-test <testId> — Generate an IaC fix and open a pull request for a specific failing test

name: vantage-critical-thinking-plugins
description: Five plugins that add reflective "why" layers to any AI output. Philosophy, History, Psychology, Sociology, and Rhetoric — each examines a question from a different vantage point. Includes a loyalty audit capability that detects whether recommendations are optimized for the user or the provider. 60 tools total. Designed to complement domain plugins (legal, finance, product, etc.) by surfacing hidden assumptions, historical precedent, behavioral barriers, power dynamics, and accountability language.

name: vaper
description: Status line widget that shows how much water you've boiled with Claude today by converting daily token usage into joules and milliliters of water heated from 20°C to 100°C.

name: vardoger
description:
vardoger personalizes Claude Code by analyzing your own conversation history and turning recurring patterns into tailored rules.

How it works: the plugin's `analyze` skill calls the `vardoger` CLI, which reads your local `~/.claude/projects/` session files in batches. Claude summarizes each batch for behavioral signals (tools you prefer, libraries you use, coding conventions you follow, mistakes you don't want repeated), then synthesizes the summaries into a single personalization that lands in your rules file. Re-running refreshes the personalization as your history grows.

Everything runs on your machine — conversations never leave your disk, there is no server or account, and the output is plain Markdown you can edit or delete. The same CLI also supports Cursor, Codex, and OpenClaw, so the personalization stays consistent across assistants if you use more than one.

name: varlock
description: Secure environment variable management with Varlock for secrets, API keys, credentials, and sensitive configuration.

name: varlock-skill
description: Secure environment variable management with schema validation and secret masking. Validates secrets are set correctly without exposing values in terminal output.

name: vastai-pack
description: Complete Vast.ai integration skill pack with 24 skills covering GPU marketplace, cloud compute, and ML infrastructure. Flagship tier vendor pack.

name: vault-pkm
description: Personal knowledge management for Claude Code. Connect to your Obsidian vault with 20 MCP tools, semantic search, wikilink graph traversal, template-based note creation, link health audits, and cross-session activity logging. Includes 3 autonomous agents and hooks for proactive knowledge capture.

name: vbnet-lsp-claude-plugin
description: vbnet-lsp adds Roslyn-powered VB.NET language intelligence to Claude Code through Language Server Protocol. It registers .vb files and launches vbnet-ls over stdio, enabling semantic diagnostics, completion, hover, definition/references navigation, and symbol-aware edits in VB.NET projects. The language server is distributed as the NuGet global tool DNAKode.VbNet.Lsp and validated in CI on Windows and Linux, including real Claude plugin validation and command checks.

name: vector-md-context-injector
description:
Vector-md-plugin provides hooks to automatically inject sub-tree scoped context files upon reading a file from said sub-tree. The injections are deduplicated per agent context. The skill file and CLAUDE.md loading hook provide guidance towards maintaining these files as a natural part of the work Claude Code does.

The idea is that these vector.md files form a knowledge graph that's automatically available to claude as needed.

name: veeva-pack
description: Claude Code skill pack for Veeva (24 skills)

name: velixar
description:
Velixar is a cognitive memory system for Claude Code. It gives Claude persistent memory, a knowledge graph, identity awareness, contradiction detection, and belief tracking across every session, not just
session logs, but a full reasoning layer.

6 skills, 1 agent, 40 MCP tools, 5 live resources, and 18 workflow prompts. Claude doesn't just remember what you said, it understands how your decisions evolved, detects when new information contradicts stored knowledge, and maintains a persistent model of who you are and how you work.

name: vellum
description: Local design-iteration skill — self-hosted alternative to SuperDesign. Iterates static HTML/CSS mockups using your real Tailwind tokens and shadcn/ui class vocabulary.

name: velt
description: Add real-time collaboration to any React or Next.js app. AI-guided setup with codebase analysis, best-practice rules, and MCP-powered tooling for the Velt SDK. Includes commands for comments, presence, cursors, CRDT collaborative editing, and notifications.

name: venture-capital-intelligence
description: 9 skills for venture capital intelligence. 3 run on pure Claude reasoning. 6 run Claude + Python for deterministic outputs — screening startups, modeling financials, sizing markets, computing cap table waterfalls, scanning deal signals, and generating LP fund reports. Built from the best open-source VC tools.

name: veracityapi
description: VeracityAPI gives Claude content verification tools for text, image, audio, and batch workflows. It helps agents triage AI-generated, manipulated, risky, or low-trust content before publishing, citing, moderating, accepting uploads, or using content as training data. Results include deterministic risk signals, evidence, and recommended_action routing such as allow, revise, human_review, or reject.

name: vercel
description: Vercel deployment platform integration. Manage deployments, check build status, access logs, configure domains, and control your frontend infrastructure directly from Claude Code.

name: vercel-pack
description: Complete Vercel integration skill pack with 30 skills covering deployments, edge functions, preview environments, performance optimization, and production operations. Flagship+ tier vendor pack.

name: verifiedx
description: VerifiedX helps Claude install and verify action protection in existing AI systems with minimal code changes. It inspects a repo, detects the smallest real integration seam such as OpenAI Agents, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph, direct model clients, MCP, raw runtimes, lower seams, or explicit wrappers, then applies the minimal VerifiedX patch without redesigning the system. VerifiedX blocks unjustified high impact actions before execution while letting the workflow continue through the right path. It can also audit an existing integration and point out missing pieces or unnecessary complexity.

name: veritasacta-verify
description: Offline Ed25519 receipt verifier — checks signed decision receipts, agent manifests, and audit bundles without contacting any server.

name: version-sentinel
description: Hard-blocks dependency additions, bumps, and downgrades until a fresh, source-cited version check is recorded via WebSearch. Supports npm, pip, Cargo, and NuGet ecosystems. Uses PreToolUse hooks to intercept manifest edits and install commands, blocking them until the developer verifies the latest version upstream.

name: versori-skills
description:
The versori-skills plugin gives Claude Code the ability to create, build, deploy, and monitor production-grade data integrations, entirely from the command line. Rather than stitching together simple automations, Versori enables Claude to build complex, multi-workflow integrations with full TypeScript control using the versori-run SDK.

The plugin follows a research-first approach: before writing any code, Claude gathers and structures API documentation for each system involved, producing a grounded research document that becomes the single source of truth for the integration. This ensures generated code is accurate and well-informed rather than hallucinated.

From there, Claude manages the full integration lifecycle: bootstrapping projects, configuring systems and connections, generating type-safe TypeScript workflows, running local validation via Deno, and deploying to production with built-in safety checks like dry-run previews and project context validation.

Key features:

- Research-grounded code generation: Claude researches API documentation before writing code, with every fact linked to its source. Research documents are uploaded as project assets so future modifications retain full context.
- Full project lifecycle management: Create, sync, deploy, version, promote, and rollback integrations without leaving the terminal. Supports multiple environments with version promotion between them.
- Complex multi-workflow integrations: Build integrations with scheduled ETL pipelines, webhook handlers, durable long-running workflows, and stateful batch processing using KV storage, going well beyond the simple trigger-action automations of platforms.
- Embedded integrations (multi-user): Supports user activations and connection management for embedded integration scenarios where end-users bring their own credentials.
- Secure credential handling: Credentials are referenced as environment variables and resolved at runtime. They are never embedded in commands or stored in code.
- Built-in deployment safety: Dry-run mode for all destructive operations.

name: very-good-ai-flutter-plugin
description:
Production-quality Flutter and Dart skills from Very Good Ventures. Provides opinionated, best-practice guidance for accessibility (WCAG 2.1), BLoC state management, testing
(unit, widget, golden), Material 3 theming, GoRouter navigation, internationalization, layered architecture, static security (OWASP Mobile Top 10), and license compliance — plus
automated dart analyze and dart format hooks that run after every code edit. Skills activate automatically based on context or via slash commands.

name: vibe-cartographer
description: Vibe Cartographer turns the vibe-coding hype into a structured workflow. Eight commands walk you from idea spark to shipped app: a flipped-interaction onboarding (/onboard), a scope brainstorm (/scope), a PRD interview (/prd), a tech spec grounded in your architecture (/spec), a dependency-aware build checklist (/checklist), an autonomous-or-step-by-step build loop (/build), an optional polish pass (/iterate), and a real retrospective (/reflect). The agent picks up a unified builder profile at ~/.claude/profiles/builder.json so persona, pacing, and stack preferences carry across projects and across other 626Labs plugins. Three Level-3.5 self-evolution commands round it out: /evolve (the plugin reads its own logs and proposes improvements), /vitals (self-diagnostic health check), /friction (real-time friction capture for future evolve cycles).

name: vibe-coding
description: Schema-first architecture discipline for AI-assisted development. Enforces tables → RLS → features ordering, generates paste-ready Claude Code prompts, and manages build queue batches. Built from the methodology behind a 511-table production app with 1,016 security policies.

name: vibe-doc
description: Vibe Doc is an AI-powered documentation gap analyzer for any codebase. It scans your project's artifacts, classifies the project type (web app, API, data pipeline, Claude Code plugin, etc.), measures coverage against a tier-appropriate documentation matrix, and either generates the missing docs from your existing artifacts or hands you a ranked list of gaps to close. Five slash commands cover the loop: /vibe-doc:scan (analyze), /vibe-doc:generate (write missing docs), /vibe-doc:check (CI deployment-readiness gate), /vibe-doc:status (snapshot), and /vibe-doc:evolve (Level-3 self-improvement — the plugin reads its own session logs and proposes SKILL improvements). Honest about coverage: no cherry-picked denominators, no false negatives the matcher has learned to flag.

name: vibe-flow
description: Orchestration skills for Vibe Kanban. Turn a spec into merged code using multi-agent waves: plan → ship → link → review → merge, with autonomous fix loops. Supports parallel wave dispatch, executor tier routing (T0 flash → T4 opus), board status transitions, and cost budgets.

name: vibe-guide
description: Non-technical progress summaries for Claude Code work (hides diffs/log noise).

name: vibe-iterate
description: Post-ship product iteration for Claude Code. Pick a banner mode — feature-add, competitive, ux-polish, or bug-bash — or reach for a sidecar (radar, spy, scan-releases, rate, ship, upgrade). Every run ships one PR, regression-aware and small-diff-preferred. The agent keeps an "Atlas" of what you've shipped, considered, and cut across sessions, and stays current on your stack via context7 plus a weekly framework-release scan. Composes with vibe-cartographer when it's installed; works standalone when it isn't. No telemetry — Atlas data stays local.

name: vibe-keystone
description: Vibe Keystone bootstraps a CLAUDE.md for any repository — the load-bearing structural file every agent decision in that repo will rest on. Unlike a generic template, Keystone interviews the user for org / decision surface / voice rules / persona before drafting, so the produced file reflects YOUR conventions, not 626Labs defaults baked in. Tenant-aware: detects the repo type from filesystem signals (code platform / marketing site / long-form writing / mixed) and adapts the produced CLAUDE.md to the right shape. Use when starting a new repo or when an existing CLAUDE.md is stale. The keystone is what every other Claude Code workflow rests on; investing 5 minutes here saves agent-confusion across hundreds of future sessions in the repo.

name: vibe-prospecting
description: Power your chat with live B2B data to create lead lists, research companies, enrich contacts, personalize outreach, and inspect business signals, tech stacks, events, and website changes. 150M+ businesses and 800M+ professionals via the Explorium MCP.

name: vibe-replay
description: Turn AI coding sessions into shareable, interactive replays. Auto-generates GitHub PR artifacts (markdown + animated GIF), self-contained HTML replays, and session analytics. Supports Claude Code and Cursor.

name: vibe-taker
description: Move a feature between repos without copy-paste archaeology. vibe-taker captures a feature out of one codebase as a portable bundle — architecture sketch, contract surface, the AI prompts that built it, a verbatim source snapshot, and the gotchas — then plants it into another repo with stack-aware adaptation. It reads source autonomously and only asks you when the WHY can't be derived from the code; on plant it detects the target's stack and picks code-lift on a high match, spec-driven re-implementation on a low one, or declines a hard cross-language mismatch — always with a diff you confirm before anything is written. Three commands: capture, plant, list. Local-only by default; ~/.vibe-taker/library/ is the single source of truth.

name: vibe-test
description: Test coverage for vibe-coded apps that actually matters. vibe-test reads your app, classifies it by type and deployment risk, and generates tests proportional to that risk — not a boilerplate dump, not a pass/fail meter. It catches the broken harnesses other tools assume away: runners that silently report 0%, missing test binaries, coverage cherry-picked over a fraction of your files. Seven commands cover audit, generate, fix, coverage, gate, and posture, and the handoff artifacts (test plan, runbook, CI stub) survive uninstalling the plugin. JS/TS today.

name: vibe-thesis
description: Academic thesis authoring in Claude Code. vibe-thesis scaffolds and co-authors thesis-shaped artifacts — dissertations, master's theses, long-form research articles, position essays — with a rendered PDF skeleton in about 30 minutes. Its voice pipeline captures whose prose anchors your writing and applies it to drafts without changing your claims, while a tone lint catches the inflationary, self-praising patterns LLM-assisted academic writing tends to accumulate. Six commands: render, status, voice, guard, smooth, audit.

name: vibecircle
description: See what your friends are building. A social feed for friend groups who vibe code — share screenshots, deploy links, and coding activity with your circle. Features: auto-capture from Claude Code via /share command, live app embeds, reactions and comments, ambient presence (see who's building right now), and AI-powered project explanations (BYOK). Includes /circle setup for zero-friction device code authentication, and /share for posting updates. Open source, MIT licensed.

name: vibeguard
description: Security auditor and hardener for vibe-coded projects. 170+ vulnerability checks across 24 categories including injection, XSS, auth bypass, IDOR, Supabase RLS, prompt injection, exposed secrets, rate limiting, CORS, and auth provider misconfigs. Three commands: /vibeguard:audit (scan and report), /vibeguard:fix (patch findings), /vibeguard:harden (add security infrastructure). Includes a pre-commit hook that blocks git commits containing hardcoded secrets.

name: vibekanban
description:
VibeKanban is a dev progress kanban board that runs entirely inside Claude Code. When you code with Claude, every task is automatically tracked — started, completed, and reported — on a local kanban board with a browser-based UI.

No cloud service, no sign-up, no npm install. Just a Python server on localhost and a single HTML file. Claude creates tasks when you ask for work, moves them through columns as progress happens, records git diff stats on completion, and writes work reports you can review later in the web UI.

Multi-project support lets you manage several codebases from one board. Switch between projects with tabs, drag cards between columns, and view completed work grouped by date, category, or development phase.

name: vibelearn
description: VibeLearn silently watches your Claude Code sessions, extracts the concepts you encounter while building, and turns them into personalized quiz questions — so you actually retain what you learn. After each session, run `vl quiz` to review with adaptive spaced repetition across 7 question formats (multiple choice, spot the bug, code reading, fill in the blank, open-ended, true/false, ordering). Difficulty adjusts automatically: 3 correct answers in a row promotes you to the next level, one wrong answer drops you back. Senior-level open-ended answers are evaluated by a 5-dimension AI rubric.

name: vibesurfer
description:
A real browser for your local AI agent. Native WebKit on macOS, WebKitGTK on Linux, WebView2 on Windows,
with a wire protocol designed for LLMs instead of for humans staring at DevTools. Login once, scrape
JS-rendered pages, fill forms, take screenshots, drive your own app for smoke tests.

name: vibiz
description: Generate ads, funnels, ICPs, social posts, and full Meta campaigns from inside Claude Code. Drafts a marketing post about every commit you make.

name: video-library-classifier
description: A Claude Code / Cowork plugin for videographers who need to organize large libraries of footage before editing in Final Cut Pro.

name: video-to-code-skill
description: Inputs the content of any video into Claude Code prompt / context window as a multimodal bundle of voice transcription and data summary, time synced with keyframes - screenshots of key moments from the video so it can be used for all further requests related to that content.

name: videozero
description: Generate 2D animations and full explainer videos with VideoZero.  Create engaging kinetic typography, illustrative charts, or animate complex algorithms and fomula.

name: viral-launch-pipeline
description: A 21-agent orchestrator for viral product launches. One skill coordinates parallel web research (YouTube, X, Reddit, industry), manager-critiqued hook and giveaway writing, a body specialist chain (weapons, controversy, technical, flow), a Mom Test for mass-market readability, and multi-channel delivery (X-thread, LinkedIn post, ProductHunt copy). Manager loops force rewrites until the rubric passes, with a full paper trail and resumable state.

name: virtual-team
description:
Virtual Team turns Claude Code into a roster of 12 senior specialists you can summon by slash command. Instead of one generic assistant trying to be everything at once, you get focused expert mindsets — a backend engineer who actually thinks about input validation and authorization, a database engineer who asks about access patterns before suggesting indexes, a security engineer who threat-models the diff in front of them, a QA engineer who builds a test strategy before writing a single test. Each persona ships with a repeatable workflow and a
 structured output contract so the answers are scannable, prioritized, and actionable — not freeform prose you have to parse.

 The plugin is project-adaptive: every persona detects your stack (language, framework, package manager, conventions, existing patterns) at invocation time, so the same
 /virtual-team:frontend call gives sharp React advice in a React repo and sharp Svelte advice in a Svelte repo, with no per-project configuration. A shared review rubric and ecosystem context layer keeps recommendations grounded in real-world tradeoffs rather than textbook generalities.

Two meta-commands tie the roster together. /virtual-team:senior-brother is your generalist mentor — bring it anything, even a half-formed thought, and it figures out what you actually need, gives you the better solution, and tells you what you're lacking and how to level up. /virtual-team:all is the parallel orchestrator — point it at a PR or a feature and it
 dispatches every relevant specialist simultaneously, then synthesizes their findings into one prioritized report with a clear ship/hold verdict.

Who it's for: indie developers and small teams who don't have a full senior bench in-house; senior engineers who want a structured second opinion before merging; anyone who's tired of the same generic AI suggestions and wants opinionated, role-specific expertise. version 3.0.0, actively maintained at github.com/Apoorve8055/virtual-team.

name: vision-specialist
description: Image and visual analysis with screenshot interpretation and text extraction

name: visual-critique
description: Visual critique skills: hierarchy analysis, brand consistency checks against mood/voice/tokens, composition evaluation, and typography audits — with a /critique-screen command that compiles a prioritised fix list.

name: visual-explainer
description: An agent skill that turns complex terminal output into styled HTML pages you actually want to read.

name: visual-explainer-marketplace
description: Plugin distribution for visual-explainer

name: visual-eyes
description: Give Claude Code the ability to see running web applications. Visual Eyes captures screenshots via Playwright, lets Claude analyze the UI visually, auto-fix layout bugs, and run pixel-level regression testing. Works with any localhost app, zero config needed. Supports desktop, mobile, and full-page captures.

description: Visual regression testing with screenshot comparison

name: visual-regression-tester

name: visual-test-pro
description: Visual Test Pro is a Claude Code plugin that visually tests your entire app in Chrome, catches security vulnerabilities, handles authentication automatically, and delivers a plain English report your non-technical co-founder could read.

name: vitaecontext
description: VitaeContext gives AI agents a private, reusable source of truth about a person's career, then provides focused skills for turning that context into grounded professional work.

name: vitals
description: Codebase vital signs — hotspot detection, ROI-ranked diagnosis, co-change coupling, knowledge risk, and AI provenance tracking

name: viv
description:
Turn Claude into a Viv expert. Design, develop, and debug code and content for Viv, a system for building simulated worlds where storylines emerge from character activity.

Viv offers technical narrative designers a custom programming language affording rich specifications of character actions, as well as constructs that drive *story sifting*—the task of identifying emergent storylines in a given simulation instance, such as a videogame playthrough.

This plugin maintains a synced copy of the Viv codebase, and bundles special commands for efficiently navigating it, allowing Claude to search the full language reference, compiler source, runtime source, and other material anytime it needs to look something up.

Skills include `/setup` for fully automated Viv installation and project setup, `/write` for authoring Viv code from a brief, `/fix` for diagnosing compiler and runtime errors, `/design` for worldbuilding and architecture planning, and `/build` for writing integration code.

name: vivid
description: Open a Vivid Business account directly from your AI chat. Share your company details or upload registration documents - the plugin extracts the data, pre-fills the onboarding form, and gives you a link to complete verification.

description: Open a Vivid Business account directly from your AI chat. Upload company registration documents or share details in conversation — the plugin extracts data, pre-fills everything, and generates an onboarding link

name: vm-disk-cleanup
description: Prevent and recover from disk-full errors in Claude's working environment — both Cowork session VMs and Claude Code sandboxes. Clears npm/pip caches, node_modules, Python bytecode, build outputs, and temp files that accumulate during long sessions.

name: voice
description: Audio feedback when Claude Code agent completes tasks using pocket-tts

name: voice-bridge
description: Give Claude Code a voice with multi-engine text-to-speech. Speaks responses aloud using 5  TTS engines (edge-tts, ElevenLabs, Kokoro, macOS say, espeak-ng). Free by default.  edge-tts uses Microsoft Neural voices with no API key. Includes a Stop hook for automatic speech, a /speak skill for on-demand use, and an MCP server with speak, set_engine, get_status, and list_voices tools. Text is automatically filtered to remove code blocks, API keys, file paths, and markdown before speaking.

name: voicenter
description: Manage Voicenter Cloud contact center real time communication with your own app or CRM using claude code and voicenter skills and mcp plugin. control calls, get real time webhooks, active auodialer campiagns, reports, users and Queues, and much more.

description: Its a full packs of command, skill, hook and mcp

name: voxflow
description: AI voice CLI bundled as 5 skills (hub, podcast, transcribe, video, slice). Synthesize speech in 200+ voices across 40+ languages, generate multi-speaker AI podcasts from a topic or URL, transcribe audio/video with word-level timestamps, dub video from SRT subtitles, run end-to-end video translation, and turn long articles into vertical card video reels via Remotion. Backed by a hosted TTS/ASR/LLM/render service with per-user quota (free tier 10K/mo).

Checks service health, analyses Nginx logs for AI crawler activity, verifies backups, manages redirects, and runs WordPress site health checks. Key features:
- LLM-driven highlights: pass a prompt ("summarize the rate decision and inflation outlook", "identify the bug and when it occurs") and Claude picks the N most relevant moments with frame + reason + verbatim quote.
- Smart dedup with perceptual hash + transcript-aware protection: typically drops 40-60% of redundant frames on screen recordings without losing narrated moments.
- OCR for screen-recording UIs: Tesseract with 2x upscale + auto-invert + PSM 6, output to grep-able ocr.txt.
- Per-step content-hash cache: re-runs are nearly free.
- Opt-in Jira posting with a confirmation gate BEFORE any attachment upload — declining leaves the ticket untouched, no orphan state.

description:
Waves is a product development framework that turns ideas into production software through a structured sequence of AI-driven artifacts. It provides the AI agent with persistent memory, project awareness, and a clear methodology — so every session starts informed, every task traces to a purpose, and every decision is recorded.

The framework guides the complete lifecycle: validate the idea (feasibility analysis with Monte Carlo and Bayesian projections and kill criteria), distill findings into validated facts (foundation), define what the product is and why it exists (blueprint with capabilities, flows, rules, and success metrics), plan delivery in organic cycles called waves (roadmaps with phases and milestones), track implementation per task (logbooks with objectives, scope, and completion guides), execute code aligned with project rules and business intent (objectives-implement), and document what was accomplished (resolutions).

Each artifact feeds the next. Each session picks up where the last one left off. The agent reads the blueprint before writing code, follows extracted coding rules, alerts when work doesn't align with the product definition, and preserves context so nothing is lost between sessions.

name: wicked-garden
description:
Wicked Garden — AI-Native SDLC

A full software development lifecycle as a single Claude Code plugin. 14 domains, 80 specialist agents, 152 commands — covering everything from requirements through production operations.

What makes it different from a good CLAUDE.md: it's executable infrastructure, not passive guidance. Hooks enforce workflow gates before Claude sees your prompt. Context from memory, search, and project state is assembled automatically on
every turn. Decisions persist across sessions. Quality gates actually block progression when evidence is missing.

Works standalone with zero external dependencies. Local SQLite storage. No API keys, no cloud services, no setup beyond install.

Core systems:

- Crew — Signal-driven project workflows with 8 phases (clarify → design → build → test → review → operate), 7-dimension complexity scoring, hard-enforced quality gates, and multi-perspective consensus review for high-stakes decisions
- Smaht — Automatic context assembly on every prompt via 3-tier routing (hot/fast/slow). Surfaces relevant memories, code search results, kanban state, and crew context without you asking
- Mem — 3-tier persistent memory (working → episodic → semantic) with auto-consolidation, tag-based search, and access-frequency ranking. Decisions from month-old sessions surface when relevant
- Search — Code intelligence with symbol search, blast radius analysis, data lineage tracing, and service map discovery
- Jam — AI brainstorming with dynamic persona focus groups and multi-model council sessions using installed LLM CLIs (Codex, Gemini, Copilot)

Plus specialist agents for engineering, product, platform/DevSecOps, QE, data, delivery, agentic architecture, and on-demand personas.

Ingest → Compile → Link → Query → Write-back → Improve
